name: cTSParticlesRenderable::UpdateParticleChildren
notes: Lane XB. Hooked; called directly by our step. Difftest Particles_Children: 120,000 seeds over both x87 precisions, both sides on the same objects (shell renderable, effect bytes, real description, tests/ts_child_nodes.h's children), order, arguments and float bits of every child call compared, plus the renderable's slots and the drawn count. Each orientation kind has its own turn, those with no case too (they leave at the first particle, the count unbumped: ORIGINAL-BUG in src). Floors per kind, rotation count, parameter, list, list end, range end, negative parameter, bound equality, colour one key / on a key / between, stopped particles, short directions, squares exactly on the near-zero float. The shape path also runs real in Particles_Effect_Frame. Colours with more than one key stay at t in [0, 1] in the wild cases: past that both sides read past the key list (the game's own read), so the test keeps to the list. Mutants: 50 on the function, 47 killed (two of them after a test gap was closed: the exact-edge squares), 3 survivors, equivalent: two compare a float against 1e-6f instead of the double (no float lies between them, the >= form was killed), and flatBack's z sign (it only meets a zero in an Add, so the sum is +0 either way).
